title: Prescribed-equation cyclic charts of a root-split cover
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], g a nonzerodivisor with regular R/(g), n a positive invertible integer, and y a prime containing g. For schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let p:Y → Spec R factor through D(g). Suppose its pullback [def-pc-fibre-product] to the punctured n-th root cover of g is a finite disjoint union of d copies of that punctured root cover, with the given isomorphism commuting with the projections. Then after a pointed affine etale neighborhood psi:Spec S → Spec R of y, put h=psi#(g). The pullback of Y is the punctured spectrum of a finite product of S[T]/(T^e-h), with positive unit exponents e, and its isomorphism commutes with the base projections. S and S/(h) are regular, and h is a nonzerodivisor. Empty products are allowed. No group, torsor or ramification hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, intermediate-root and descent paragraphs; Tags 02LA and 02VN

proof.text: Apply the existing cyclic chart model, which already keeps the equation equal to the image of g. Its statement permits every point, so the additional divisor-point hypothesis hy is not needed.
Apply the existing etale regular divisor base change theorem to the ring map of that model. Combine the witnesses and use Spec.preimage_map to identify the prescribed image with the ring-map image.

lean.statement:
theorem root_split_cover_prescribed_cyclic_charts
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hg : IsSMulRegular R g)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hj : ∃ j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g),
      j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    (d : ℕ) (y : Spec R) (hy : g ∈ y.asIdeal) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (ψ : Spec S ⟶ Spec R) (z : Spec S),
      Etale ψ ∧ ψ z = y ∧
      let h := (Spec.preimage ψ).hom g
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : S)) ∧
        IsRegularRing S ∧ IsSMulRegular S h ∧
        IsRegularRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {h}) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C h)))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C h))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C h)) h)
        ∃ γ : pullback p ψ ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p ψ
